title: My child has issues with balance. Can occupational therapy help?
metaTitle: Improving Balance with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network's Occupational Therapists work on your child's balance issues, improving core strength, coordination, and motor planning skill.
html: Absolutely, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that children with autism can struggle with balance. Our Occupational Therapy interventions focus on improving your child's core strength, coordination and motor planning through engaging activities. This helps them gain confidence in their movements and improve balance.
